mapper.select: SELECT id, idempotency_key, payload_hash, investigation_id, status, started_at, completed_at, last_error_code, created_at FROM investigation_api_request WHERE investigation_id = #{investigationId} ORDER BY id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO investigation_api_request (idempotency_key, payload_hash, investigation_id, status) VALUES (#{idempotencyKey}, #{payloadHash}, #{investigationId}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE investigation_api_request SET status = 'RUNNING', started_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE investigation_api_request SET status = #{status}, completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, last_error_code = #{errorCode} WHERE id = #{id}
